title: Alpha++ process discovery

steps: 1. Compute DF relations with min_support threshold
2. Build L1L = activities a where (a,a) in DF (length-1 loops)
3. Build L2L = pairs (a,b) where (a,b) and (b,a) both in DF and a!=b (length-2 loops)
4. Build Alpha++-aware causal relation: standard causal OR L2L pair
5. Collect place candidates (A,B): all a in A causally precede all b in B; within-A and within-B activities are in # relation
6. Expand candidates greedily by merging compatible pairs on A-side and B-side
8. Construct Petri net: source/sink places, transitions per activity, places per maximal candidate, self-loop places for L1L, back-arc places for L2L
key_alpha_plus_plus_extensions: L1L detection: self-following activities get a self-loop place (t_a -> p_loop_a -> t_a)
L2L detection: back-arc places for mutual DF pairs (t_b -> p_back_a_b -> t_a)
L2L pairs reclassified from Parallel to Causal in footprint matrix
